_comment: DETERMINISTIC MANIFEST OF EVERY PROJECT-LOCAL MEEPHASH FILE THAT CAN AFFECT THE DAEMON'S
meepow_v2 COMPILATION.
HOW IT WAS DERIVED, not assumed. The 23 source/header entries are the files the compiler
actually opened while building the meepow_v2 and blake3 targets, read back out of the real
build's CMake dependency data (meepow_build/CMakeFiles/<target>.dir/compiler_depend.internal)
and filtered to paths under meepow/. The 24th, meepow/CMakeLists.txt, is the build-selection
input: it decides which sources those 23 are.
WHY 24 IS SUFFICIENT, AND WHY A NEW FILE CANNOT SLIP IN. meepow/CMakeLists.txt names every
source explicitly -- there is no file(GLOB) anywhere in it -- so no file can enter this build
without editing CMakeLists.txt, and CMakeLists.txt is in this manifest. The daemon's own
CMakeLists.txt forces MEEPOW_LIB_ONLY=ON and MEEPOW_BLAKE3_PORTABLE=ON, so the BLAKE3 SIMD
sources (blake3_sse2.c, blake3_sse41.c, blake3_avx2.c, blake3_avx512.c) are NOT compiled;
turning them on would require editing CMakeLists.txt, which this manifest would catch.
WHAT THE AGGREGATE IDENTITY PROVES. That the daemon was compiled against THESE EXACT BYTES of
the proof-of-work implementation. It catches the ordinary and dangerous case: a modified or
dirty MeepHash tree compiling into a daemon whose source lock passes.
WHAT IT DOES NOT PROVE. It is not a review of the algorithm, not a statement that MeepHash-W
v2 is sound, and not a claim about the resulting binary's correctness. It says which bytes
went in, nothing about whether they are good bytes. It also says nothing about the compiler,
libc, or flags -- those are recorded separately in the build manifest.
WHY THE HELPER'S 26-FILE SOURCE ID IS NOT REUSED HERE. scripts/helper-source-inventory.txt is
a conservative superset for a DIFFERENT target (meepow-v2-helper) and deliberately omits
CMake/build-selection inputs. Overlapping, but neither is a subset of the other, so the two
identities are kept separate rather than conflated.
consumed_by: the daemon's meepow_v2 library, via add_subdirectory(${MEEPCOIN_MEEPOW_DIR})
derivation: compiler_depend.internal of the meepow_v2 and blake3 targets, filtered to meepow/, plus meepow/CMakeLists.txt
aggregate_identity_recipe: sha256 over the sorted '<sha256>  <repo-relative path>\n' lines of the files below
head_meepow_tree_note: The git tree of meepow/ at the main repository's HEAD. Informational: it proves what the repository holds, not what a build read. The per-file hashes below are the contract.
v2_frozen_note: The peeled commit of the v2-frozen tag. Informational only: a tag is a movable label, so it is recorded for provenance and is NOT trusted by the verifier. Nothing is accepted because a tag says so.
